list: Official 55 trophies as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (2026-11-18): 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden
note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's official wording. Guides are written in our own words for this entry and cite their sources beside each trophy. Where the official description gives no precise location, the guide stays general and says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. Follow the roadmap in this guide in order — story first, then collectibles and activities — and it will pop last.
steps: Earn all 54 other trophies.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end. It is the first story mission, so it cannot be missed — just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission completes.
steps: Start the story and finish the Gone Fishing mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story trophies unlock as the chapters end, so keep playing the main story in order and this pops when the chapter closes.
steps: Complete all Chapter 1 story missions.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable in normal play — it unlocks when the chapter's final mission ends.
steps: Complete all Chapter 2 story missions.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Keep the main story moving; side activities can wait until after the story if you prefer, since chapter progress is what counts here.
steps: Complete all Chapter 3 story missions.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so it pops as the story reaches its final stretch.
steps: Complete all Chapter 4 story missions.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission. It is the story's last beat and the gold trophy for completing it — pay attention to any choice the finale offers, because a final mission can only be replayed from a save made before it, so keep a manual save before starting it.
steps: Keep a save before the final mission.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a named mission trophy, so it pops when that mission ends; if you use mission replay, replay Breakfast Run itself to pick it up.
steps: Play the Breakfast Run story mission to completion.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions usually have a setup phase first, so finish every setup the game asks for, then the heist itself — the trophy pops at the mission's end.
steps: Finish the setups for The Cartel Heist.
Complete The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Follow the mission's objectives to the end; as a named-mission trophy it unlocks on completion, not on any optional objective.
steps: Play the Child's Play story mission to completion.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Named-mission trophies only need the mission finished, so focus on surviving its objectives rather than on optional style goals.
steps: Play the Headliners story mission to completion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The name points to an airport job, so expect vehicle and on-foot sections; finish the mission and the trophy pops.
steps: Play the VCIA Takedown story mission to completion.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The operation name suggests a large set-piece, so stock up on ammo and armour before starting, then play it through to the end.
steps: Prepare ammo and armour.
Play Operation Savage Glory to completion.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist. That checklist covers the story, stranger missions, collectibles and activities, so treat this as the long grind after the finale: use the tracker's collectibles and activities filters to mop up what is left, and check the in-game stats page for the exact remaining percentage.
steps: Finish the story.
Complete stranger strands, collectibles and activities until the in-game checklist reads 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts in free roam — jumps, near misses and airtime all count toward the total the game tracks. The fastest honest route is to repeat a reliable jump or stunt spot you already know, rather than hunting new ones; the counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so it builds up naturally while you travel.
steps: Use jumps and stunt spots in free roam.
Repeat until the tracked count reaches 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — the official list counts 9 types. Work through the activities menu one by one in free roam (races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, drone races and the rest) and tick each off in this tracker as you try it; you only need to try each once, not win or master it.
steps: Open the activities list in free roam.
Try each of the 9 activity types once.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — the count is the one PlayStation tracks. Learn each range's target pattern first with a bronze run, then push for gold; use the steadiest weapon you own and take your time between shots, since accuracy beats speed on most ranges.
steps: Visit the Shooting Range.
Earn gold in all 42 challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's turns on a practice run, then race to win — the trophy needs a win at every location, not just one, so keep a list of the locations you have already won and revisit the rest.
steps: Find each of the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win a race at each one.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different courses count, repeats of the same course do not. Spread your wins across race types and locations, and note each new win in this tracker so you do not waste time re-winning a course that already counted.
steps: Enter races across different courses.
Win 20 different ones.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head, so watch Cal's catch rate and focus on steady reeling rather than rushing; challenge him again if you lose — but do it before the story moves past his availability, which is why this is flagged missable here.
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge.
Beat Cal at it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game to its end. Pick the shortest or easiest cabinet you find in an arcade, learn its controls in the first minute, and play it through — a single completed game is all this trophy asks.
steps: Enter an arcade.
Complete any one arcade game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Stranger-style strands unlock as you meet the character in free roam, so keep returning to Andy's marker whenever it appears until his last mission is done.
steps: Meet Andy and play his missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. As with the other character strands, the missions appear in order in free roam — clear each one when its marker shows, and the trophy pops at the end of the last.
steps: Meet Kenton and play his missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Billy's strand is bike-flavoured by its name, so expect riding missions; play them in order until the last one completes.
steps: Meet Billy and play his missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Explore the map in free roam and answer every stranger marker you see; each strand is several missions long, so finish one strand fully before moving on, and use this tracker to count the strands you have completed toward 8.
steps: Find stranger markers across Leonida.
Complete 8 full strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Play his missions in the order they appear; the trophy unlocks only at the strand's end, not part-way through.
steps: Meet Randy and play his missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Keep an eye on the map for Tyrone's marker between story chapters and clear each mission as it appears.
steps: Meet Tyrone and play his missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points on the map — visit each one and use the meditate prompt there; tick each spot off in this tracker as you go so you can see which of the 18 remain.
steps: Find the 18 meditation spots across Leonida.
Meditate at each one.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunt will point you at a specific animal — follow his clues and the in-game tracking, take the shot cleanly, and return to him; the trophy is for that one unique hunt, not for general hunting.
steps: Meet Bret and take his hunt.
Track and hunt the unique animal.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect them as you explore and check which sets are nearly complete first — finishing 3 sets is the goal, not collecting every single card in the game.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida.
Complete 3 full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. This is a long grind, so fold it into normal travel: WAiNK It whenever you pass a new spot rather than saving all 100 for the end, and watch the tracked count climb toward 100.
steps: Use WAiNK It at new locations as you travel.
Reach 100 locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges cover many small feats, so open the challenge list, pick the easiest unfinished ones first, and work through them in batches — the count is cumulative, so every finished challenge moves you toward 50.
steps: Open the challenge list.
Complete 50 challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it in an open area with a fast car ready: gain the wanted level together, then break line of sight, hide until the stars clear, and stay with your partner until the heat is gone.
steps: Have your partner with you.
Reach a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them — the chain breaks if the heat drops. Plan a route of 3 close shops, rob each quickly, and keep moving; do not hide or wait between robberies, or the chain resets.
steps: Have your partner with you.
Rob 3 shops back-to-back while keeping your wanted level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Driving or entering a new vehicle model counts it as discovered, so try every new car, bike, boat and plane you see rather than sticking to one favourite; the count climbs fastest when you explore new areas with varied traffic.
steps: Enter or drive new vehicle models as you find them.
Discover 100 vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies group together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain your shots without letting the effect end — if you fall short, retry the same spot; the trophy needs all 5 inside one activation.
steps: Find a spot with 5+ grouped enemies.
Activate Combat Focus and down 5 in that one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — the description points to taking a plane out without a scheduled flight. Get to a plane at VCIA, take off, and fly away from the airport; the trophy pops on the departure itself, so do not land back at VCIA first.
steps: Go to VCIA and get to a plane.
Take off and leave the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description points to Rhino tanks and heat — expect this to involve a Rhino, most likely at a high wanted level. The official wording gives no exact step, so treat this as a combat trophy to attempt when a Rhino appears: get into or around a Rhino under fire and survive the encounter. Keep the guide general here rather than inventing a precise trigger the sources do not state.
steps: Find a Rhino tank encounter.
Complete the encounter involving the Rhino.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and stay undetected the whole time. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards' sightlines, take the loot, and leave before any alarm — if you are spotted, leave and retry, because detection fails the attempt.
steps: Enter a jewelry store quietly.
Rob it and leave without being detected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vault robberies bring heavy police attention, so plan a fast getaway vehicle before you start, grab the loot, and break away cleanly — repeat at 5 different vaults; the count is cumulative.
steps: Plan a getaway vehicle.
Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks travel set routes in traffic — stop one, take its cash, and get away before the police close in; a fast car parked nearby makes the escape much easier.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Rob it and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks which areas you have visited, so drive through every region — cities, coast, swamps and countryside — until the explored count reads 52; use the in-game map to spot the areas you have not entered yet.
steps: Travel through every region of Leonida.
Visit all 52 areas.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal operations are gang-run spots on the map — hit one per gang, all 9, and the trophy pops; if you are unsure which gang owns a spot, the in-game information for that location is the guide to trust.
steps: Find illegal operations across Leonida.
Rob one for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy it with the view — a quiet moment trophy, so take it slowly and let the scene play out.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Have a cocktail with the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in the classic style the description nods to — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out. Pick a showroom, get in a car inside it, and drive out through the front; the trophy is for the exit itself.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom in a car.
Smash out through the front.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — play a game there to its end. The trophy is tied to that specific alley, so go to the Kolt & Associates location rather than any other bowling spot.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a game through.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague — a partnership moment with mass appeal. The official wording gives no exact step, so this is one to attempt during a big partnered moment in the story or in free roam with your partner, and to check against a full guide (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies.org) once its trigger is documented. This guide does not invent a step the sources do not state.
steps: Play partnered moments with your partner.
Watch for a large public or crowd moment together.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices in the game — the description and the count PlayStation tracks suggest this is about the choices you make along the way. Keep playing and choosing whenever the game offers a decision; the trophy unlocks as your choices accumulate, so there is no single moment to hunt for.
steps: Play the story and side content.
Make choices whenever the game offers them.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — the description says it plainly. Fail something once, then succeed at the same thing on the next attempt; the trophy is for the comeback, so do not reload an old save to erase the first failure.
steps: Fail an attempt at something.
Succeed at it on the second try.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description is a reaction, not an instruction. Strange sightings in Leonida are usually found by exploring odd places at odd hours, so keep exploring off the beaten path; the official wording gives no exact location, so this guide does not invent one.
steps: Explore unusual places across Leonida.
Witness the strange event when it happens.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Drive slowly past a target on foot, swing as you pass, and keep moving; it needs the hit to land from the vehicle, so practise the timing at low speed first.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Land a melee hit on someone while driving past.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; hand them to your contacts to clean them, and the total adds up across the playthrough — keep laundering every batch instead of spending dirty money directly.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies.
Launder $250,000 through your contacts.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food and everything else counts toward one total. There is no need to buy anything useless: just spend normally through the game and the total will climb, topping up on big purchases late in the story if you are short.
steps: Shop normally through the game.
Spend $100,000 in total across shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages appear for sale on the in-game property market — save up, buy each one as you can afford it, and check the property list to see which of the 8 you still own.
steps: Save money from story and side work.
Purchase all 8 garage properties.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you find a vehicle you like, register it in the app instead of just driving it away — 10 registrations is the goal, and different vehicles count, so register a spread of cars and bikes.
steps: Find vehicles in free roam.
Register 10 of them in the Scooter Bros app.
